escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>"
    options = ConversionOptions(escape_asterisks=True, escape_underscores=False)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
